column1: # Printed set codes (app redesign #173): the code a collector reads on a card or in a deck list ("PAL 185"), by TCGdex
# set ID. Catalog shows it in place of the TCGdex set ID and its search accepts it ("PAL 185", any case). A set not listed
# here shows and searches by its TCGdex set ID. Display and search only: this is not the Live export table
# (catalog_targets.LiveRulesV1.SET_CODES, which needs Live-import evidence) and no export reads it.
# Rule for a row (api/tests/test_set_codes.py enforces it): two independent sources give the same code, or the code is
# printed on a card scan and one other source agrees; no source read gives a different code. A subset whose cards
# TCGdex lists as its own set, numbered with a prefix the main set doesn't use (TG, GG, SV), inherits its main set's
# code ("I:<main set ID>"), because its cards print that code.
#   L        Limitless TCG card database set list, https://limitlesstcg.com/cards (read 2026-10-13)
#   J        JustInBasil, Appendix I: Set Symbols and Abbreviations, https://www.justinbasil.com/guide/appendix1
#            (read 2026-10-13; it lists sets up to Stellar Crown)
#   S:<card> the code printed at the bottom left of that card, on its TCGdex scan
#   I:<set>  inherits that main set's code (see above)
# TCGdex's own "abbreviation" and "tcgOnline" fields are never a source, and neither are sites that mirror them.
# Left out on purpose (each shows its TCGdex set ID):
#   base4 (Base Set 2: BS2 in L, B2 in J), ecard1 (Expedition: E1 / EX), ecard2 (Aquapolis: E2 / AQ),
#   ecard3 (Skyridge: E3 / SK): the sources disagree.
#   sve, mee (energy sets), mfb, pop1-pop9, ru1, smp, xyp, bwp, hgssp, dpp, np: one source only, and no card scan.
#   swshp: the sources disagree (SP in L; Pokémon TCG Live uses PR-SW).
#   cel25cc: TCGdex numbers it CC001-CC025, which is not what the cards print.
#   30th-c, xya, basep, bog, miscp, ex5.5, exu, fut2020, the McDonald's Collections and the trainer kits: no code found.
# Columns, tab-separated: TCGdex set ID, printed code, set name (as in imported_sets.txt), sources.
